pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose the matching portal route in the Journey Guide. Mark the return portal before exploring; a safe return mark is advice, not a hidden objective. The native guide also covers Leptictidium with a Pouch of Seeds and Gnatusuchus with Raw Fillet as small excavation-helper pathways. No animal click

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Explore Paleogene, Neogene and Pleistocene eras. Formations are biome-like regions within each dimension. Content scope is three dimensions, not two.
